content:
A Laredo man was sentenced Friday to 10 years in prison on each of two counts of intoxication manslaughter for a 2023 crash that killed two people at Del Mar Boulevard and Casa Verde Road, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Matias Cerda pleaded guilty on October 14 to the two manslaughter counts, and to one count of intoxication assault in a separate 2025 case. Judge Marco A. Salinas of the 406th District Court sentenced Cerda to 10 years on each manslaughter count, plus five years for the intoxication assault, on Friday, November 6. Cerda was credited for time served and remanded to the Webb County Jail pending transfer to the Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

The fatal crash happened on March 7, 2023, at about 11:48 p.m. at the intersection of Del Mar Boulevard and Casa Verde Road. Cerda was driving a 2014 white Toyota Tundra pickup east on Del Mar Boulevard at an estimated speed of more than 120 mph when he ran a red light and collided with a 2020 red Toyota RAV4 traveling north on Casa Verde Road, according to the report.

Erick Alberto Moreno Rodriguez, 46, the driver of the RAV4, was pronounced dead at the scene. Brayan Morales Alvarez, 25, a passenger in the RAV4, was taken to a hospital and pronounced dead on March 8, 2023. A third person in the RAV4, Maria Isabel Moreno, was hospitalized with serious bodily injuries.

Cerda's blood alcohol concentration was measured at 0.213, more than twice the legal limit of 0.08, according to the report. A 17-year-old passenger in Cerda's vehicle told police Cerda had been drinking beer at a quinceañera, had refused to let him drive, and was racing another vehicle before the crash.

Cerda was released on a $25,000 bond in 2023, but his bond was revoked and he was jailed in 2025 after his bond conditions were modified. Victim impact statements were read in court by Maria Isabel Moreno, her daughter Elizabeth, and her mother Maria Guadalupe Trevino. Assistant District Attorney Fernando Gallegos prosecuted the case, and Roberto E. Montelongo represented Cerda. A presentence investigation report was prepared by District Attorney's Office investigator David Garcia. The judge also took into consideration a 2024 evading arrest or detention with a vehicle case and a 2023 felony drug case in another county.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, November 7, 2026.

title: Laredo man gets 10 years for 2023 crash that killed two
